scope: Per-cell inventory of ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3 Table 31 (page object dictionary), with focused review of inheritance, box/default handling, rotation/UserUnit, page AA, Resources, Contents, Group and VP. Linked clause suites are sampled, not certified wholesale.

source.primary: ISO_32000-2_sponsored_EC3.pdf, §7.7.3.3 Table 31 physical pages 119–122 / printed pages 104–107; §7.7.3.4 begins at physical 122 / printed 107. Locators verified against extracted page content and visible footers.
source.table_31_entry_source: Table31 rows and notes were read from primary extraction around Table heading (layout lines 6815–6989); not inferred from ledger summaries.
source.cross_cutting: §7.7.3.4 inheritance physical 122 / printed 107 onward; §7.8.2 Contents processing physical 125–126 / printed 110–111; §14.11.2 boxes; §12.6.3 page triggers; §8.11.4 page groups; §12.9 VP/measurement.

inheritance_rule.semantics: Only entries explicitly marked inheritable in Table 31 inherit. Nearest ancestor value wins as-is, including full dictionaries/arrays without merging. Missing optional inheritable value uses its row default; a required inheritable value must occur on page or an ancestor.
inheritance_rule.writer_note: Linearized PDF rules have a separate producer-side requirement that inherited page attributes be explicit on page dictionaries; this is not an ordinary reader rejection obligation.

ec3_changes.location: Table 31 Resources row, physical 120 / printed 105; completed note annotation
ec3_changes.effect: Clarifies a Resources dictionary must be specified directly or through inheritance even if Contents is absent. Producer-validity clarification; does not prescribe malformed-reader rejection.

ec3_changes.location: Table 31 /B row, physical 121 / printed 106; StrikeOut removes 'natural'
ec3_changes.effect: Aligns the table's bead order with the corrected §12.4.3 reading order. The paired clause correction is reviewed in outlines_threads_current; Table31/Table12.4.3 presence wording still differs.
Adds PDF 2.0 deprecation. The changes compose; /ID is deprecated in PDF 2.0 and not a current page-rendering feature.

matrix.rule: Required /Page for a page object or /Template for an invisible named-page template.
matrix.evidence: Selected page-vs-node identity and template routes are tested; not all damaged prefixes.

matrix.rule: Required indirect parent of a Page; Template must omit Parent.
matrix.evidence: Normal parent chains and named templates are covered; malformed-reference outcomes are recovery policy.

matrix.rule: Required if PieceInfo exists; otherwise optional PDF 1.3 page modification date.
matrix.evidence: Conditional producer relationship mapped; this pass did not independently assert every page PieceInfo/date interaction.

matrix.rule: Required, inheritable dictionary; if page needs none, empty dict; omission means inherit. Writers should not share this way.
matrix.assertions: inherited_resources_spec_audit nearest dictionary/empty shadow; content_resources_audit actual execution; Type3 resource tests
matrix.evidence: Nearest whole dictionary and empty override have unit assertions; one-level runtime inherited resource test. A multi-level runtime rendering draft exists in page_resources_current and remains unrun by that shard.

matrix.rule: Required, inheritable rectangle in default user space defining physical medium.
matrix.assertions: page_geometry numeric dimensions; page_boundaries_current literal rendered controls
matrix.evidence: Inheritance, local override, defaults/recovery and consumer selection have source-derived controls; see B19 challenge residual for empty intersections.

matrix.rule: Optional, inheritable visible region; default MediaBox.
matrix.assertions: page_boundaries_current tests explicit and default boundaries plus output pixels
matrix.evidence: Current shard reports inherited CropBox through public render/leaf override PASS; this is newer evidence than page_resources_current's earlier residual.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.3; default CropBox; production clipping region.
matrix.assertions: page_boundaries_current literal boundary and clip tests
matrix.evidence: Selected values and ViewClip behavior covered; no whole prepress certification.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.3; default CropBox; intended finished page after trim.
matrix.assertions: page_boundaries_current literal defaults, selection and clipping
matrix.evidence: Selected viewing paths covered; actual printer/output-device imposed trimming is not claimed.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.3; default CropBox; meaningful content extent.
matrix.evidence: Selected geometry/style choices covered; no assertion that the implementation-dependent imposition equals box extents.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.4 boundary guideline styles; if absent application uses current defaults.
matrix.evidence: Selected style/default and View-vs-Print routes are exercised; full host preference matrix not re-audited.

matrix.rule: Optional; absent means empty; one stream or ordered array with at least one whitespace between parts. Writers may split only at token boundaries and must not produce an empty array.
matrix.evidence: Cross-part operands/operator, whitespace, order, absent/null, invalid/damaged parts, and aggregate budget have discriminating tests. Preserving original array structure is not required.

matrix.rule: Optional, inheritable integer multiple of 90; default 0; clockwise.
matrix.owner: page transforms, render and navigation geometry
matrix.evidence: Inheritance and numeric/device placement controls exist; selection_census deliberately excludes rotations for its separate comparison contract.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.4 page group attributes for transparency model.
matrix.assertions: B39 same-object alpha compositing and transparency foundation/compositing shards; color/overprint suites
matrix.evidence: Current page Group is consumed with selected independent formulas/pixel controls. No whole transparency/backend certification from this cell.

matrix.rule: Optional thumbnail image stream for this page.
matrix.evidence: Thumbnail image decoding/placement has dedicated tests; distinction from Filespec /Thumb is explicitly documented.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.1; recommended when page contains article beads; array of indirect bead refs in reading order (effective #320); forbidden on Template.
matrix.evidence: Issue #320 resolves order to reading order; one-thread sequence is asserted. Table31 Optional/recommended and §12.4.3 shall-contain wording remain inconsistent; no reader rejection duty is inferred.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.1 display duration; default is no automatic advance.
matrix.evidence: Page presentation timing has targeted tests; broader automated slide-show behavior is not certified.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.1 transition dictionary for presentation display.
matrix.evidence: Selected transition entries/defaults are exercised; not a test of every visual transition/backend.

matrix.rule: Optional array of indirect refs to all annotations associated with page.
matrix.assertions: annotations, page trigger, annotation appearance and associated file tests
matrix.evidence: Broad annotation routes are covered; malformed/missing annotation entries remain policy and not all subtypes are certified.

matrix.rule: Optional page additional-actions dictionary, PDF1.2; non-inheritable from PDF1.3.
matrix.owner: pdf-model::action::for_page; viewer-core navigation page trigger events
matrix.evidence: Direct and indirect AA/O public URI controls executed PASS in form-page-wave87b.log. See parent-review.json; no host delivery or timing certification.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.4 metadata stream containing page metadata.
matrix.evidence: Page/catalog metadata distinction is owned under metadata; this pass did not trace every page packet consumer.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.3 page-piece dictionary.
matrix.evidence: Private page-piece information may be ignored by general-purpose processors under §14.5; LastModified conditional mapped, no page rendering obligation inferred.

matrix.rule: Required integer if page contains structural content items; key into structure ParentTree.
matrix.evidence: Page-keyed structure semantics are reviewed in those shards; this pass does not re-certify complete tagged-PDF semantics.

matrix.rule: Optional page digital identifier, PDF 1.3; indirect reference preferred was removed by #106, deprecated PDF 2.0 by #619.
matrix.evidence: EC3 changes verified; no current page display consumer identified.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.3 preferred zoom for natural display magnification in web capture.
matrix.evidence: Feature family is deprecated/inapplicable in effective PDF 2.0 scope; no general page zoom default is derived from PZ.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.3 separation information for page color separations.
matrix.evidence: Reader's screen/render color path is separately audited; page separation output is not claimed by this app. Optional producer field does not imply a screen-reader requirement.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.5 tab order; R,C,S; PDF2 also A,W.
matrix.evidence: Selected keyboard order values and tagged fallback are tested; not every malformed-structure case.

matrix.rule: Required if page created from named page; originating name.
matrix.assertions: named_page, APRef and FDF import suites
matrix.evidence: Named-page association and visible page-conversion consumers reviewed; no unconditional requirement to synthesize this marker for ordinary pages.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.5 first navigation node for sub-page navigation.
matrix.assertions: navigation tests around page PresSteps and presentation controls
matrix.evidence: Model traversal/order has focused fixtures; full host slide navigation is outside this Table31 matrix.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.6 positive scale in multiples of 1/72 inch; default 1; supported range implementation-dependent; not inheritable.
matrix.assertions: page_geometry, coordinate_graphics_state, color/image consumers, transform tests
matrix.evidence: Literal dimensions/pixel-placement tests and ancestor non-inheritance control exist; the numerical maximum is implementation-dependent, so no invented ISO upper bound.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 1.6 ordered array of page viewport dictionaries.
matrix.assertions: measurement_numeric_spec_audit, measuring.rs and measurement model tests
matrix.evidence: Valid page viewport arrays feed public measure/coordinate queries; many detailed geometry tests. Viewports are not page viewport defaults or page-box replacements.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 2.0 array of one or more file specification dictionaries associated with page.
matrix.evidence: Public extraction distinguishes page and catalog associations; exact file payload assertions exist. Page AF zero-population in curated corpus is not treated as lack of feature support.

matrix.rule: Optional PDF 2.0 array specifying output device color characteristics for this page.
matrix.assertions: output_intents_current, ICC and colour context shards
matrix.evidence: Selected public consumers and independent color oracles exist; synthetic-profile fixture qualification remains in those shards.

matrix.rule: Required if page belongs to a DPart range; prohibited otherwise; indirect ref to covering part.
matrix.evidence: Reciprocal ranges/page references and AF/public consequences have focused assertions; hierarchy depth bound is explicitly qualified in DPart shard.

current_gap_candidate.behavior: Page /AA action dictionaries can be represented indirectly under general object rules; current page action tests found all direct page /AA and direct /O action forms.
current_gap_candidate.source: Table 31 /AA physical p.121 / printed p.106; §7.3.10 general indirect-object equivalence; page /AA is explicitly non-inheritable in Table31 and §7.7.3.4 lists only four inherited keys.
current_gap_candidate.implementation: pdf-model/src/action.rs::for_page calls Document::get_key(page, "AA") then action::read on the selected entry.
current_gap_candidate.test: drafts/page_aa_indirect_reference_spec_audit.rs compares a direct valid control with indirect /AA and indirect /O, both returning the literal page-open URI through Viewer.
current_gap_candidate.verdict: Now executed PASS; bounded public indirect-object control, not a defect.

partial_scope: Does not recertify the entire page-tree graph, all annotation or structure semantics, every transition effect, every viewport type, or every backend.
Public indirect-AA test executed PASS; other cell links remain selected partial review.
Table 31 field absence and writer constraints are not automatically reader error obligations.
